Chapter 1326 - 10: Chaos Taiji Third Level

Chapter 1326: Chapter 10: Chaos Taiji Third Level

The Myriad Realms Gate remained grand and imposing, as if unchanged for eons.

Lin Yuan observed carefully, each time he gazed at the Myriad Realms Gate, he felt different.

Buzz~ Lin Yuan split a thread of his consciousness, following the third coordinate deep within the Myriad Realms Gate, seeking to observe the third Origin World from the perspective of the Myriad Realms Gate.

This was something Lin Yuan did every time he traversed and descended.

But the next moment.

Lin Yuan received a warning from the Myriad Realms Gate.

"Danger?"

"Could the third Origin World pose a threat to me?"

Lin Yuan immediately withdrew his consciousness and fell into deep thought.

The so-called danger refers to the possibility, as judged by the Myriad Realms Gate, of causing irreversible damage to several of Lin Yuan’s main original forms and numerous Primordial Spirit incarnations.

Lin Yuan’s several main original forms are completely independent and causally isolated.

However, to affect several main original forms at once, does not necessarily rely on causality.

Memory would do as well.

After all, several main original forms share memories.

If there were a contamination of memory and mind, it would definitely affect all real forms and Primordial Spirit incarnations.

During the initial exploration of the first Origin World, as Lin Yuan peered into the second Origin World with his mind,

he received a similar warning.

Subsequent events proved that the warning from the Myriad Realms Gate was very necessary.

The Demonic Qi pollution of the second Origin World involved the mental level.

With Lin Yuan’s mind consciousness at the time, even a trace of contamination would inevitably cause irreparable damage and injury.

And it would also affect real forms and original forms in other dimensional spaces.

The Demonic Qi of the second Origin World was essentially the remnants of a Time Lord’s power.

The level was unimaginably high.

It was simply not something Lin Yuan at the time could resist.

And now.

In the exploration of the third Origin World.

Lin Yuan also received a similar warning.

"What kind of world is the third Origin World that it could pose a genuine threat to me now?"

Lin Yuan was startled.

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, the fall of a major real form or incarnation was no threat at all.

At worst, descend again and regroup.

The real threat is the means or harm that implicate real forms and original forms in other dimensional spaces.

And with Lin Yuan’s current strength, combined with causal independence and isolation, there already weren’t many that could cause such results.

"Perhaps there exists a living Time Lord in the third Origin World?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The methods and abilities of a Time Lord are often unfathomable.

A powerful Time Lord has the slight power to alter the past.

Of course, unless this Time Lord is desperate,

otherwise, they would not dare to alter the past, even slightly.

Altering the past is very likely to attract the attention of a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being.

The higher the level of life, the more fearful they are of a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being.

After all, Thirteenth Rank time beings already stand at the apex of all beings, but in reality, the so-called time beings are very likely just ’toys’ inadvertently created by a Perfect Time Being.

Because only a Perfect Time Being allows it, time beings can exist.

This realization has caused panic among many time beings.

"Forget it."

Lin Yuan shook his head, feeling it was wiser to take heed of the warning.

He hadn’t intended to officially explore the third Origin World before stepping into the Thirteenth Rank.

Now Lin Yuan’s strength had reached a bottleneck in all aspects, the only thing that could still be enhanced was the Chaotic Taiji Dao.

And the Chaotic Taiji Dao doesn’t need the exploration of Origin Worlds to be improved; Lin Yuan, who comprehended the Yin Yang Twin Flowers, had already made rapid progress in the comprehension of Chaotic Taiji Dao.

Therefore.

Even if there were gains from exploring the third Origin World now,

it wouldn’t provide substantial help to Lin Yuan.

It’s better to explore slowly after stepping into the Thirteenth Rank.

...

In a location incredibly distant from the Chaos Void.

An endless and boundless Milky Way swept through numerous time-spaces, sweeping through the universe and everything in it, magnificent and unceasing, the mere power of this Milky Way could cause alarm to many time beings.

This was the Milky Way dimension, an extremely special, non-exclusive dimensional space.

Precisely because it was non-exclusive, the Milky Way dimension bore nearly a hundred time beings, aside from those born locally, many time beings came from numerous other dimensional spaces.

"Heart of the Heavenly River."

Amidst the magnificent central part of the Milky Way, the main battle bodies of seven time beings from the Chaos Void stood aloft, gazing far into the depths of the Milky Way, where a heart completely condensed by the Origin Power of the Milky Way was gradually taking shape.

"At most four thousand years, and this Heart of the Heavenly River will be fully formed."

Lord Mo Xu was in good spirits; leveraging the Heart of the Heavenly River, he could not only feel the operation of the Origin Rule of the Milky Way up close but also use it as a congratulatory gift for Lin Yuan, as a present for his breakthrough to the Thirteenth Rank.

"Hmm?"

"Not good?"

Lord Mo Xu observed the gestation of the Heart of Heavenly River while watching the future timelines.

At this moment, one future timeline, which initially had a small probability, suddenly expanded rapidly, almost occupying a third of all the future timelines Lord Mo Xu could observe.

"What is this?"

Lord Mo Xu’s expression turned grave, "Do the time beings of the Taixu Dimension also want to vie for this Heart of Heavenly River?"

The Taixu Dimension is a powerful dimensional space, not weaker than the Chaos Void. During this great cataclysm, nine time beings were born from the Taixu Dimension, exerting immense dominance in the gaps between surrounding dimensions.

"What exactly happened that made the time beings of the Taixu Dimension want to compete for this Heart of Heavenly River?"

Lord Mo Xu looked puzzled. In the many future timelines he previously observed, the possibility of the Taixu Dimension making a move to compete was very small, almost negligible, virtually impossible.

Yet just a moment ago, this possibility began to explode infinitely, now occupying almost a third.

It must have been affected by some other factors, causing the time beings of the Taixu Dimension to suddenly become determined to obtain this Heart of Heavenly River.

The future holds infinite possibilities and infinite variables. Perhaps the once almost certain future has been completely overturned by some subtle change.

Even beings as strong as Thirteenth Rank time beings try to develop the future as they wish, but whether it can truly happen, even the time beings themselves cannot be sure.

"Lord Mo Xu, that Taixu Dimension..."

The other six time beings also acted in succession. They too noticed the changes in the future timelines, their expressions turning grave.

"Regardless of the reason, according to the development of the future timelines, the Taixu Dimension will almost certainly compete with us for this Heart of Heavenly River."

Lord Mo Xu said.

The past that has already happened is not important.

It is the many time beings from the Taixu Dimension, about to come over and compete, that they must face.

"So, what do we do now?"

Asked the time being dressed in black armor, frowning.

The Taixu Dimension has nine time beings in command, which exceeds the Chaos Void by a notch in terms of Thirteenth Rank quantity.

"What to do?"

"Naturally, we fight."

Said the time being with a human head and snake body, "Since the Taixu Dimension wants this Heart of Heavenly River, let them show their strength."

The Heart of Heavenly River is a treasure schemed by the seven time beings of the Chaos Void over endless ages, for which they made numerous concessions and compromises with other forces in the Milky Way Dimension.

How can it be given up just like that?

Thirteenth Rank time beings are most adept at weighing pros and cons; just the time beings of the Taixu Dimension are not enough to make the seven time beings of the Chaos Void concede.

"Yes."

"Then let’s fight."

Lord Mo Xu nodded.

In terms of the number of time beings, the Taixu Dimension surpasses the Chaos Void.

But in Thirteenth Rank level battles, unless there’s absolute overpowering strength, the numerical advantage isn’t very apparent.

The most crucial point is, if they don’t even fight this time and concede the Heart of Heavenly River, the status of the seven time beings of the Chaos Void will drop significantly in the Milky Way Dimension.

"The strongest Thirteenth Rank in the Taixu Dimension is not as strong as I am, so if we really fight, we have a chance of winning."

Lord Mo Xu said.

The battles among Thirteenth Rank time beings are mainly about who can see more timelines and find the one where their side has the highest chance of victory.

As for direct confrontations? Just act at the key time nodes.

It’s rare to see relentless battles.

Battles where no victory can be decided have little meaning.

Unless relentless battles are part of the time beings’ plan.

.....

Chaos Void.

A mysterious flower containing the extreme forces of Yin and Yang was slowly blooming before Lin Yuan.

Within the flower, Yin and Yang merged, existed independently, and transformed into each other, similar to the essence of the Taiji Dao.

Because of this similarity, coupled with the fact that the flower was born of the highest rule of the dimensional gap, it could guide Lin Yuan to the direction of the third level of Chaos Taiji.

"Yin and Yang, Taiji..."

Lin Yuan immersed himself into their study and enlightenment, countless inspirations flooding into his mind.

[Your insight is extraordinary, comprehending the mysterious flower, your understanding of the Chaotic Taiji Dao greatly enhances...]

Almost every moment, Lin Yuan’s insight into the Chaotic Taiji Dao soared, countless insights beginning to accumulate, endlessly accumulating, forming the foundation for an eventual breakthrough.

...

Time passed.

Three thousand years passed in the blink of an eye.

During these three thousand years, almost all of Lin Yuan’s mind was devoted to understanding the Yin Yang Twin Flowers, and the accumulation over these three thousand years finally erupted at some moment.

[Your insight is extraordinary, comprehending the mysterious flower, the Chaotic Taiji Dao has been enhanced to the third level...]

...

In a daze.

Lin Yuan seemed to stand at an entirely new height.

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan, who had been sitting cross-legged with eyes closed, suddenly opened his eyes.

"So that’s how it is?"

Lin Yuan’s eyes were one black and one white, akin to the Chaotic Taiji, rapidly spreading and diffusing in all directions, over a hundred times with blackness, overwhelming and sweeping everything.

"So that’s how it is!"

Lin Yuan whispered to himself. At this moment, nearly a fifth of the Chaos Void was covered in the black and white of Yin and Yang, continuously intertwining, colliding, and evolving, endlessly.

"So that’s how it is."

Lin Yuan closed his eyes again, the black and white Yin and Yang covering nearly a fifth of the Chaos Void quickly dissipating, along with the Chaotic Taiji mark at his brow vanishing.

Everything returned to tranquility, everything reverted to its original state.
